overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a quorum did not deliberate outside the posted June 30 meeting on the Board's reorganization, since the only pre-meeting contact reached two of five members. The letter also reminded the Board in a footnote that its minutes failed to record roll call votes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the Planning Board deliberated outside a posted meeting before the June 30 vote reorganizing the Board and electing a new chair.
allegations.key_passage: Any communication between Mr. Atkins and Mr. Pfaff did not constitute deliberation because those communications only reached two out of the five-member Board, which is not a quorum.
